answer: Strongest points against the requirement: hybrid/mild‑hybrid battery packaging already reduces usable boot volume (multiple complaints), so meeting the strict suitcase-volume criterion may be challenging in some variants; numerous reports of unreliable key/keyless tailgate behaviour and spontaneous self‑closure suggest the high reliability/zero‑incident trial target will be hard to prove without engineering changes; customers also cite missing practical fittings (tie‑downs, internal close button) and some ingress/egress awkwardness. Little else speaks against keeping the requirement — most evidence argues the need is real rather than unnecessary.
